findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Starbucks 承認並非每個細分市場都居領先，美國大型快餐業者可能壓低客流與客單，全球面臨既有品牌、新進入者與小型專業業者競爭，對手可能以同價或更低價搶份額。
findings.excerpt: We face increasing competition in all channels and markets and do not hold leadership positions in every segment. In the U.S., large quick-service competitors offering coffee, tea, and other competitive products may reduce customer traffic and transaction value. Globally, competition from established brands, new entrants, and smaller specialty operators may hinder growth and impact sales.

findings.claim: AP/Technomic：星巴克占美國咖啡店消費支出份額由 2023 年 52% 降至 48%，Dutch Bros、Luckin 等連鎖競爭加劇
findings.source: AP via Fortune, Starbucks feels the heat as more chains compete for US coffee drinkers
findings.excerpt: it now stands at 48%, down from 52% in 2023, according to Technomic, a food industry consulting firm. Dunkin ‘, a perennial rival that just opened its 10,000th U.S. store, gained market share in both of those years. Starbucks has other challengers, like the fast-growing drive-thru chains 7 Brew, Scooter’s Coffee and Dutch Bros.

findings.claim: Luckin 與 Cotti 進入美國市場，以 $2–3 價位低價切入
findings.source: eMarketer, Chinese coffee companies Luckin and Cotti plot US expansion
